best_human.provenance: Reconstruction of Gordon, Kuperberg and Patashnik (1995), sections III-IV, finite geometry and induced coverings. AG(5,2) hyperplanes restricted to 24 points, padded to 14. The deleted eight-point subset was selected by this implementation. This is a published-method baseline, not a published 62-block record.
best_human.ai_provenance: AI implemented the published method and selected the restriction.
best_human.evidence_state: 62 blocks independently cover all 10626 four-subsets exactly

best_public.provenance: La Jolla repository record, corroborated by the James Yu covering project which reports best known 23 and proves a lower bound of 20.
best_public.origin_type: unknown unless attribution is stated in source/provenance

best_reproduced.provenance: La Jolla Covering Repository witness, archived in the Zenodo dataset v1.2; the archive records the 23-block improvement by Andrei Ochmat on 2004-07-20. Labels 1..24 were converted to 0..23 for the local evaluator.
best_reproduced.ai_provenance: AI retrieved and converted the archived witness; the task evaluator independently checked all blocks and four-subsets.

survey_scope_note: Best public means the strongest same-parameter result in the cited checked sources. This is not a claim that every public source has been surveyed. Unmatched parameters are listed separately.
frozen_human_baseline_type: reconstruction of a published human method; weaker than best public record
